newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.AFRICA PLAYERS RECEIVE MINIMUM GUARANTEE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICA PLAYERS RECEIVE MINIMUM GUARANTEE.

text.p: Players called up from outside the current South African squad this season will be guaranteed a minimum payment of 13,250 rand, the United Cricket Board said in Johannesburg on Monday.

Those cricketers who do not already have contracts will be paid a "category C" retainer of 10,000 rand for the month in which they are selected plus a match fee of 3,250 rand for one-day internationals or 9,750 rand for test matches.
The C category is the lowest grade of three contracts on which South Africa's squad players are currently retained.
If an uncontracted player plays in two test matches or six one-day internationals he will receive a full UCB contract until the end of May 1997.
The UCB also announced they will take part in two one-day tournaments in Singapore and Canada next year.

They will play India and Pakistan in Singapore between May 25 and June 1. In the second tournament they will then meet West Indies, Sri Lanka and Canada in a quadrangular tournament in Toronto from July 19 to July 27.
